# vyos.blueprints.vrf_firewall

VRFs with route leaking and firewall (docs blueprint "VRF and firewall example")

- Creates VRFs with their routing tables, puts interfaces (including VLANs) into them, adds static routes including routes into another VRF (route leaking), sets the global state policy and configures the IPv4 forward and input filters.
- Interface addressing belongs to `vyos.blueprints.base`; PPPoE is not configured here.
- VLAN, PPPoE and other non-ethernet VRF bindings and inter-VRF routes use vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos_interfaces and vyos_vrf cannot express them yet. Everything else uses resource modules.
- In firewall rules, match an interface in a non-default VRF by the VRF name for `inbound_interface` and by the interface name for `outbound_interface`, as the docs page explains.
- Lockout risk - the input filter defaults to drop. Allow the interface or VRF you manage the router through before running the role.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.vrf_firewall
```

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs` | list | yes |  | VRFs. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.name` | str | yes |  | VRF name, e.g. `MGMT`. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.table` | int | yes |  | Routing table id. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.description` | str |  |  | VRF description. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Member interfaces, e.g. `eth1`, `eth2.150`, `pppoe0`. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.routes` | list |  | `[]` | IPv4 static routes in this VRF. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.routes.dest` | str | yes |  | Destination prefix. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.routes.interface` | str |  |  | Outgoing interface. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.routes.vrf` | str |  |  | VRF the interface belongs to, for routes into another VRF. |
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs.routes.next_hop` | str |  |  | Next-hop address (routes within this VRF only). |
| `vrf_firewall_bind_to_all` | bool |  | `true` | Set `vrf bind-to-all`, as on the docs page. |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules` | list |  | `[]` | Rules for traffic between VRFs (`firewall ipv4 forward filter`). |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.number` | int | yes |  | Rule number. |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.action` | str |  | `accept` | Rule action. |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.description` | str |  |  | Rule description. |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.inbound_interface` | str |  |  | Inbound interface or VRF name; wildcards like `eth2*` allowed. |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.outbound_interface` | str |  |  | Outbound interface name; wildcards allowed. |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.protocol` | str |  |  | Protocol. |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.source` | dict |  |  | Source match (`address`, `port`). |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.destination` | dict |  |  | Destination match (`address`, `port`). |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_rules.log` | bool |  | `false` | Log matches. |
| `vrf_firewall_forward_default_action` | str |  | `drop` | Forward filter default action. |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules` | list |  | `[]` | Rules for traffic to the router itself (`firewall ipv4 input filter`). |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.number` | int | yes |  | Rule number. |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.action` | str |  | `accept` | Rule action. |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.description` | str |  |  | Rule description. |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.inbound_interface` | str |  |  | Inbound interface or VRF name; wildcards like `eth2*` allowed. |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.outbound_interface` | str |  |  | Outbound interface name; wildcards allowed. |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.protocol` | str |  |  | Protocol. |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.source` | dict |  |  | Source match (`address`, `port`). |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.destination` | dict |  |  | Destination match (`address`, `port`). |
| `vrf_firewall_input_rules.log` | bool |  | `false` | Log matches. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every VRF exists with its member interfaces.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vrf_firewall_vrfs` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
